capabilities: Compare two npm lockfiles (versions 2 and 3) selected from the vault
Label version changes as major, minor, patch, downgrade, or other
Create a Markdown report with counts, version rows, and links to both source files
Keep root and nested installations and scoped names as separate rows
Save named file pairs and fixed project baselines for repeat comparisons (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a security or compatibility audit; it only compares recorded package versions and does not check advisories, licenses, or breaking changes.
extras: Freemium: comparison and reports are free without an account; named pairs and baselines require Pro via GitHub Sponsors, verified by a GitHub device-flow sign-in that stores the token in Obsidian's secret storage. Inputs are limited to 2 MiB and 10,000 package-map entries. Yarn and pnpm lockfiles, mobile devices, and live paid GitHub accounts were not tested. After minor or major updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to diff two dependency snapshots and record the version changes as a note next to project documentation.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: npm lockfile diff tool that compares two lockfile snapshots in the vault and writes a Markdown report of package additions, removals, and version changes.
